paragraphs: Rav Yitzḥak bar Naftali spoke to Ravina, Ketubbot (96a). Yuḥasin brings Yaakov bar Naftali, in Ravina's time; I did not find mention of him, and perhaps it is a scribal error [Rif, Semag and Rivash give Yaakov in the same exchange with Ravina].
